svg.text: KEPT, CANCER IN PANDA LABEL MASK (NOT A MODEL OUTPUT)
THREE OF ITS TILES · 256 PX AT ~5×
One label for the whole slide, dozens of
tiles. Iris has to learn which ones matter.
Real biopsy from the PANDA challenge dataset (Radboud), tissue mask and tiling by Iris.
